nodes.name: Delivery options input
nodes.description: Captures the customer's delivery address and their eventual delivery-option selection.

nodes.name: Delivery options display
nodes.description: Presents priced delivery promises and the current selection to the customer.

nodes.name: Checkout quote request
nodes.description: Starts delivery estimation with the cart and checkout context supplied by the checkout workflow.

nodes.name: Selected delivery promise
nodes.description: Returns the customer's final delivery choice to the checkout workflow for order placement.

nodes.name: Shopping cart
nodes.description: Stores the products and quantities that must be fulfilled together with the dimensions and weight needed for shipping.

nodes.name: Warehouse inventory
nodes.description: Stores available-to-promise quantities by product and fulfillment center.

nodes.name: Fulfillment policy
nodes.description: Defines eligible fulfillment centers, handling times, carrier restrictions, split-shipment penalties, and the allowed delivery window.

nodes.name: Address validation service
nodes.description: Normalizes the entered address and returns its deliverability, geographic coordinates, and postal region.

nodes.name: Carrier rates service
nodes.description: Returns shipping prices, service levels, and estimated transit times for proposed packages and routes.

nodes.name: Build candidate fulfillment plans
nodes.description: Constructs feasible ways to allocate the cart across fulfillment centers and package the allocated items.
nodes.algorithm: For each cart item, find fulfillment centers with enough available-to-promise inventory and permitted service to the destination region. Build allocations incrementally, pruning any partial allocation that exceeds the maximum shipment count or cannot fulfill every remaining item. Consolidate items assigned to the same center into packages using the policy's weight and dimension limits. Deduplicate equivalent plans by their center, item, and package assignments.

nodes.name: Rank delivery options
nodes.description: Combines candidate plans with carrier quotes and selects a small set of meaningful delivery choices.
nodes.algorithm: For each quoted plan, calculate its total shipping price and promised date from warehouse handling time plus carrier transit time. Discard plans outside the allowed delivery window. Remove plans dominated by another plan that is both cheaper and no slower. Score the remainder using shipping price, split-shipment penalty, and delivery-risk buffer; return the cheapest, fastest, and best-scoring options with deterministic ties by promised date and plan ID.

nodes.name: Delivery quote session
nodes.description: Retains the ranked options, their expiration time, and the customer's selected option for the active checkout.

relationships.data: The street address, locality, postal code, and country entered by the customer.
relationships.purpose: Obtains a normalized, deliverable destination before fulfillment work begins.

relationships.data: The normalized address, deliverability result, coordinates, and postal region.
relationships.purpose: Supplies the destination used to filter fulfillment centers and construct carrier routes.

relationships.data: Cart lines containing product ID, quantity, unit weight, and package dimensions.
relationships.purpose: Defines the items every candidate plan must allocate and package completely.

relationships.data: Available-to-promise quantities for the cart's products, grouped by fulfillment center.
relationships.purpose: Prevents the planner from proposing allocations that a warehouse cannot fulfill.

relationships.data: Center eligibility, packaging constraints, carrier restrictions, and the maximum shipment count.
relationships.purpose: Constrains the search to operationally valid fulfillment plans.

relationships.data: Candidate packages with origin, destination, dimensions, weight, and permitted carrier services.
relationships.purpose: Requests comparable prices and transit estimates for every feasible shipment leg.

relationships.data: Candidate plan IDs with their warehouse allocations, packages, and handling times.
relationships.purpose: Provides the plan structure needed to combine carrier quotes and calculate complete delivery promises.

relationships.data: Per-package carrier quotes containing service level, price, transit time, and quote expiration.
relationships.purpose: Supplies the external cost and timing information used to compare candidate plans.

relationships.data: Handling times, delivery-window limits, split-shipment penalty, and delivery-risk buffer.
relationships.purpose: Defines how raw carrier quotes become customer-facing prices and promised dates.

relationships.data: The cheapest, fastest, and balanced delivery options with prices, promised dates, plan IDs, and expiration time.
relationships.purpose: Retains a stable set of options so display and later selection refer to the same underlying quotes.

relationships.data: The active delivery options and the currently selected option ID.
relationships.purpose: Shows the customer the available prices and dates while keeping the displayed selection synchronized.

relationships.data: The option ID selected by the customer.
relationships.purpose: Retains the chosen delivery promise for the remainder of checkout without recalculating the quote.

relationships.data: The cart ID, checkout ID, currency, and customer delivery preferences.
relationships.purpose: Supplies the external workflow context needed to load and evaluate delivery plans.

relationships.data: The selected option's plan ID, service level, price, promised date, and quote expiration.
relationships.purpose: Hands the final delivery commitment back to checkout for inclusion in the order.
